# Alpine Shopify Cart

A headless Alpine.js plugin providing the $cart magic for Shopify Liquid storefronts. Independent project by Billy Noyes, MIT licensed. Version 1.0.0 is available on npm.

Install: npm install alpinejs@^3 alpinejs-shopify-cart@1.0.0
Register the module with Alpine.plugin(shopifyCart) before Alpine.start(). For CDN use, load the plugin before Alpine with defer on both scripts; do not load Alpine twice.

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/alpinejs-shopify-cart)
- [Version-pinned CDN](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs-shopify-cart@1.0.0/dist/alpinejs-shopify-cart.min.js)
- [Documentation](https://alpinejs-cart.billynoyes.co.uk/docs/)
- [Source](https://github.com/BillyNoyes/alpinejs-shopify-cart)
- [Compatibility fixes](https://github.com/BillyNoyes/alpinejs-shopify-cart/pull/2)

Uses Shopify.actions.getCart(), updateCart(), and openCart(). Observes standard shopify:cart events. No request interception, default action overrides, cart drawer markup, or analytics. Methods return promises; handle rejected errors separately from resolved userErrors and warnings.

The landing demo uses the actual plugin with an in-memory transport. It does not connect to Shopify or place orders.
